simple.meaning: שְׁמֹנֶה (shᵉmôneh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a cardinal number, eight (as if a surplus above the 'perfect' seven); also (as ordinal) eighth.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 109 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 5:4. Its contexts include family, family line, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁמֹנֶה (H8083).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
